hypotheses.reasoning: A long-running transaction (template-svc-reconciler, active 82s) held a row lock on notifications in notif-db. Other UPDATEs hit lock wait timeouts and template-svc statement timeouts. notification-svc then timed out calling template-svc. The pool saturation and gateway 504s are downstream symptoms. The metrics-agent errors and billing-reconciler are red herrings.

verdict.recommendedAction: Kill the lock-holding transaction 93036 on notif-db. Fix the reconciler to commit in short transactions, and add lock and statement timeouts.
